## Overview

This interactive map document was created on **October 7, 2026** using **R Markdown** and the **Leaflet** R package.

It showcases the **New 7 Wonders of the World**, featuring interactive markers, popups with location details, Wikipedia links, and multiple tile layer options (OpenStreetMap, Satellite, and CartoDB Light).

## Interactive Leaflet Map

```{r wonders-map, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# Create dataframe of the 7 Wonders of the World
wonders <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "Great Wall of China",
    "Petra",
    "Christ the Redeemer",
    "Machu Picchu",
    "Chichén Itzá",
    "Colosseum",
    "Taj Mahal"
  ),
  location = c(
    "Huairou, Beijing, China",
    "Ma'an, Jordan",
    "Rio de Janeiro, Brazil",
    "Cusco Region, Peru",
    "Yucatán, Mexico",
    "Rome, Italy",
    "Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India"
  ),
  lat = c(40.431908, 30.328960, -22.951916, -13.163141, 20.684285, 41.890210, 27.175145),
  lng = c(116.570374, 35.444832, -43.210487, -72.544963, -88.567783, 12.492231, 78.042142),
  wiki_url = c(
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_Wall_of_China",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Petra",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christ_the_Redeemer_(statue)",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machu_Picchu",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chichen_Itza",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colosseum",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taj_Mahal"
  ),
  category = c("Historical Wall", "Ancient City", "Statue", "Incan Ruins", "Mayan Pyramid", "Amphitheatre", "Mausoleum")
)

# Build popup HTML content
wonders <- wonders %>%
  mutate(
    popup_content = paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding: 5px;'>",
      "<h3 style='margin: 0 0 5px 0; color: #2c3e50;'>", name, "</h3>",
      "<p style='margin: 0 0 5px 0;'><b>Location:</b> ", location, "</p>",
      "<p style='margin: 0 0 5px 0;'><b>Category:</b> ", category, "</p>",
      "<a href='", wiki_url, "' target='_blank' style='color: #2980b9; text-decoration: none; font-weight: bold;'>Learn More on Wikipedia &rarr;</a>",
      "</div>"
    )
  )

# Render Leaflet Map
leaflet(wonders) %>%
  addTiles(group = "OpenStreetMap") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "CartoDB Light") %>%
  addAwesomeMarkers(
    lng = ~lng,
    lat = ~lat,
    popup = ~popup_content,
    label = ~name,
    icon = awesomeIcons(
      icon = 'star',
      iconColor = 'white',
      library = 'fa',
      markerColor = 'darkblue'
    )
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("OpenStreetMap", "Satellite", "CartoDB Light"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = 15, lat = 20, zoom = 2)
```
